items.title: First Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India (SPAI)
items.category: GS Paper III - Environment and Ecology
items.summary: The Wildlife Institute of India (WII) released the first-ever scientific population assessment of snow leopards in India, reporting a total of 718 individuals across the Himalayan region.
key_takeaways: Ladakh holds the highest population (477), followed by Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh.
Snow Leopard IUCN Status: Vulnerable; Wildlife Protection Act, 1972: Schedule I.
Crucial for questions on high-altitude ecosystem conservation and Project Snow Leopard.

items.title: RBI Framework on Climate-Related Financial Risks
items.category: GS Paper III - Indian Economy & Banking
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued draft guidelines for Regulated Entities (REs) requiring mandatory climate risk disclosures and sustainable finance practices.
key_takeaways: Aims to address greenwashing and mandate disclosure of physical and transition climate risks.
Aligns Indian banking with Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) standards.
Relevant for economics topics regarding green financing and systemic financial stability.

items.title: Supreme Court Scope on Article 142 Extraordinary Powers
items.summary: The Supreme Court delivered a landmark judgment clarifying the limits and application of Article 142, stating that extraordinary powers cannot override explicit statutory provisions.
key_takeaways: Article 142 empowers the apex court to pass any order necessary for doing 'complete justice'.
Reiterates balance of powers between Judiciary and Legislature.
Important for Indian Polity questions on Judicial Activism vs Judicial Overreach.

items.title: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
items.summary: India finalized the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement with the European Free Trade Association (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland), securing a $100 billion investment commitment over 15 years.
key_takeaways: First trade agreement for India with a commitment of targeted FDI investment.
Focuses on tariff reductions, service exports, and intellectual property rights.
Crucial for questions on bilateral trade networks and India's FTAs.

items.title: ISRO Tests Semi-Cryogenic Engine Development
items.category: GS Paper III - Science & Technology (Space Technology)
items.summary: ISRO achieved a major milestone by successfully conducting hot-tests of its 2000 kN semi-cryogenic engine at the ISRO Propulsion Complex in Mahendragiri.
key_takeaways: Uses refined kerosene (Isrosene) as fuel and Liquid Oxygen (LOX) as oxidizer.
Designed to enhance payload capacity of LVM3 and future Next Generation Launch Vehicles (NGLV).
Highly relevant for indigenous space technology developments and deep-space missions.
